cc:Work.dc:title: supplementary_figure_s1_cross_domain_state_priority_gallery
cc:Work.dc:description: Supplementary Figure S1. Cross-domain state-conditioned priority gallery. Rows show one specimen from each of six held-out domains, selected as the lexicographically first specimen in the sorted domain roster without using outcomes or effects. Left and right panels show the registered 3.13% initial and 18.75% states for the same one-shot mechanical-oracle trajectory. Overlays are within-state percentiles of strict-OOF teacher value on the registered 8x8 legal action grid. The gallery demonstrates qualitative breadth and does not define cross-panel absolute value magnitudes.
